args.title: Bellwether Office newsletter summary: Cold-chain logistics in 2026
args.body:
- Newsletter: The latest Bellwether Office newsletter highlights "Cold-chain logistics in 2026," pointing readers to the full article on its blog and a personalized companion piece on its insights site.
- Article: Temperature excursions fell 30% where carriers shared live sensor data, and most savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than less spoilage.
- Companion piece: Pilots cut claims by a quarter.
